cards.ex: We always deck the halls with boughs of holly before Christmas.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim Rojdestvodan oldin uyni holly novdalari bilan bezatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bayram uchun uyni bezaklar bilan to'ldirish, ayniqsa Rojdestvo uchun.

cards.ex: The decorations really created a festive atmosphere at the wedding.
cards.exUz: Bezaklar to'yda haqiqatan ham bayramona muhit yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Bayram bilan bog'liq bo'lgan xursandchilik, quvonch va tantanavorlik tuyg'usi.

cards.ex: In the spirit of Thanksgiving, let's share what we're grateful for.
cards.exUz: Minnettordaylik ruhi bilan, keling, nimadan minnatdormiz, shuni baham ko'raylik.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir g'oya yoki tuyg'u bilan mos ravishda, unga muvofiq.

cards.ex: This year, we decided to break with tradition and go skiing for Christmas.
cards.exUz: Bu yil biz urfdan voz kechib, Rojdestvo uchun chang'iga borishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: An'anaviy tarzda qilinadigan narsani qilmaslik, urfga zid harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The company will mark its 50th anniversary with a gala event.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining 50 yilligini gala tadbir bilan nishonlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim voqeaning yilligini maxsus tadbir bilan nishonlash.

cards.ex: Our annual family camping trip is a cherished tradition.
cards.exUz: Oilaviy har yilgi sayohatimiz qadrdon an'ana hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: O'ta muhim va qadrlanadigan an'ana.

cards.ex: Giving thanks before a meal is a time-honored custom in many cultures.
cards.exUz: Ovqatdan oldin minnatdorchilik bildirish ko'plab madaniyatlarda qadimiy odatdir.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan va hurmat qilinadigan odat.

cards.ex: My grandmother always puts on a feast for Thanksgiving.
cards.exUz: Buvim har doim Minnettordaylik kuni uchun to'kin dasturxon yozadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p turdagi va mazali ovqatlar bilan bezatilgan dasturxon yozish.

cards.ex: Their engagement is definitely a cause for celebration.
cards.exUz: Ularning unashtirilishi, albatta, bayram qilishga sababdir.
cards.uzDef: Bayram qilish uchun yetarli darajada muhim yoki yaxshi bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Even though times are changing, they still stick to their traditions.
cards.exUz: Vaqt o'zgarayotganiga qaramay, ular hali ham o'z an'analariga sodiq qolishadi.
cards.uzDef: An'analarni saqlash va ularga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: We light candles in remembrance of those who have passed away.
cards.exUz: Biz o'tib ketganlarning xotirasiga sham yoqamiz.
cards.uzDef: O'tganlarni eslash va ularga hurmat bildirish.

cards.ex: The town's summer festival is a popular annual affair.
cards.exUz: Shaharning yozgi festivali mashhur yillik tadbir.
cards.uzDef: Har yili sodir bo'ladigan voqea yoki tadbir.

cards.ex: New York City is a cultural melting pot, with people from all over the world.
cards.exUz: Nyu-York shahri - butun dunyodan odamlar yashaydigan madaniy qorishma.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar aralashib, birga yashaydigan joy.

cards.ex: Graduation is often seen as a rite of passage into adulthood.
cards.exUz: Bitiruv ko'pincha voyaga yetishning o'tish marosimi sifatida ko'riladi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdagi muhim o'tish davrini belgilaydigan marosim yoki tadbir.

cards.ex: Street festivals often foster a strong sense of community.
cards.exUz: Ko'cha festivallari ko'pincha kuchli jamiyat tuyg'usini uyg'otadi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda bo'lish, qo'llab-quvvatlash va umumiy qadriyatlarga ega bo'lish hissi.

cards.ex: The decorations were all in keeping with the Victorian theme.
cards.exUz: Bezaklar barchasi Viktoriya uslubiga mos edi.
cards.uzDef: Biron-bir narsaga yoki qoidaga mos ravishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: They really pulled out all the stops for their daughter's wedding.
cards.exUz: Ular qizining to'yi uchun barcha imkoniyatlarni ishga solishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bayram uchun eng yaxshi narsalarni ishlatib, hammadan o'tib ketish.

cards.ex: The country's bicentennial was a landmark celebration.
cards.exUz: Mamlakatning ikki yuz yilligi muhim bayram edi.
cards.uzDef: Unutilmas va muhim ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan bayram.

cards.ex: The town is steeped in tradition, with many festivals and customs.
cards.exUz: Shahar an'analarga boy, ko'plab festivallar va urf-odatlar mavjud.
cards.uzDef: An'analar bilan to'lib-toshgan, ko'p an'analar mavjud bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Graduating from college marks a significant milestone in one's life.
cards.exUz: Kollejni tugatish odamning hayotidagi muhim bosqichni belgilaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim yutuqni yoki voqeani nishonlash.

cards.ex: The festival showcased the city's tapestry of cultures.
cards.exUz: Festival shaharning madaniyatlar guldastasini namoyish etdi.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar birga aralashib, boy va rang-barang manzara yaratadi.

cards.ex: The ancient ruins are of great significance to historians.
cards.exUz: Qadimgi xarobalar tarixchilar uchun katta ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Juda muhim yoki qimmatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: The tea ceremony is a sacred ritual in Japanese culture.
cards.exUz: Choy marosimi yapon madaniyatida muqaddas marosimdir.
cards.uzDef: Diniy yoki ma'naviy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan marosim.

cards.ex: Everyone was in the festive mood, singing carols and exchanging gifts.
cards.exUz: Hamma bayram kayfiyatida edi, qo'shiqlar kuylashdi va sovg'alar almashishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bayram bilan bog'liq bo'lgan xursandchilik va quvonch tuyg'usida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The monument was built to pay homage to the war heroes.
cards.exUz: Yodgorlik urush qahramonlariga hurmat bajo keltirish uchun qurilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir hurmat ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: We got the good news, so let's break out the bubbly!
cards.exUz: Biz yaxshi xabar oldik, shuning uchun keling, shampan ochamiz!
cards.uzDef: Bayramni nishonlash uchun shampan ichmoq.

cards.ex: Baking gingerbread houses is a holiday tradition for our family.
cards.exUz: Zanjabil uylari pishirish - bizning oilamiz uchun bayram an'anasi.
cards.uzDef: Har yili bayramda bajariladigan an'ana.

cards.ex: The New Year is often a time for reflection and making resolutions.
cards.exUz: Yangi yil ko'pincha fikrlash va rezolyutsiyalar qabul qilish vaqtidir.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish haqida o'ylash va hozirgi vaziyatni baholash vaqti.

cards.ex: The Diwali celebrations are a feast for the senses, with lights, colors, and delicious food.
cards.exUz: Diwali bayramlari chiroqlar, ranglar va mazali taomlar bilan hissiyotlar bayramidir.
cards.uzDef: Ko'rish, eshitish, hidlash, tatib ko'rish va tegish orqali zavqlanish mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Joining a club gave me a sense of belonging at university.
cards.exUz: Klubga a'zo bo'lish menga universitetda tegishlilik hissini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir guruhga yoki joyga tegishli ekanligini his qilish.
